title: At the natural history museum
scene: Taras's class visits the natural history museum. They see a dinosaur, a dodo, old primates like the gibbon, an artifact and a fragment of an old bone, learn how each organism lives, watch a chameleon, a cocoon and termites that use pheromones, and read about fauna and even cannibalism among animals.

words.ex: My son loves books about dinosaurs.
The dodo was a bird that could not fly.
The museum shows artifacts from ancient Egypt.
They found a fragment of an old vase.
Bacteria are tiny organisms that live almost everywhere.
A chameleon can change its color.
The caterpillar spun a silk cocoon.
Termites damaged the wooden floor in our kitchen.
Ants follow a pheromone trail to find food.
Magma rises from deep under the ground.
Hot lava flowed down the mountain.

old_story: On Tuesday, Anna's little brother Taras visits the natural history museum with his class. First, they see a huge [[dinosaur]] and a [[dodo]], a bird that couldn't fly. In the next hall, Taras's favorite [[primate]] is the [[gibbon]], with its long arms. In a glass case, they see a stone [[artifact]] and a [[fragment]] of mammoth bone. The guide says every living [[organism]] needs food, water and a home. In a warm tank, a [[chameleon]] slowly changes its color from green to brown. Taras finds a silk [[cocoon]] hanging on a small branch. Behind glass, [[termites|termite]] build a mud tower and follow a [[pheromone]] to find food. One room shows the [[fauna]] of Ukraine, from wolves to storks. In the last hall, a model volcano shows red [[magma]] rising from deep underground. On the bus home, Taras says he wants to be a scientist.

title: A weekend in Paris
scene: Anna and her mama spend a weekend in Paris. A waiter says 'Bonjour, monsieur' to a man, 'madame' to Mama and 'mademoiselle' to Anna; they eat madeleines, creme brulee and brie in a bistro, buy a beret, pay a lot of euros, admire the facade of an old chateau, and drink cognac and pinot noir in a wine bar, dressed a la old movie stars.

words.ex: Good evening, monsieur, welcome to our hotel.
"Madame, your table is ready," said the waiter.
"Thank you, mademoiselle," said the waiter with a smile.
She dipped a madeleine in her tea.
She ordered creme brulee for dessert.
We ate brie with crackers and grapes.
She wore a red beret to the party.
We visited a beautiful chateau in France.
She wore a red dress a la old movie stars.
Herr Schmidt is our new German teacher.
Frau Müller is our German teacher.

old_story: On their weekend in Paris, Anna and Mama find a small [[bistro]]. The waiter says, 'Bonjour, [[monsieur]],' to an old man. Then he smiles at Mama: 'Good afternoon, [[madame]].' 'And for you, [[mademoiselle]]?' he asks Anna. Anna orders [[madeleines|madeleine]] and [[creme]] brulee, and Mama orders [[brie]]. After lunch, Anna buys a red [[beret]] for twenty [[euros|euro]]. On Sunday, they take a train to an old [[chateau]]. Its stone [[facade]] is white and beautiful. In the evening, they dress up [[a la]] old movie stars. At dinner, a man at the next table drinks [[cognac]]. Mama has a glass of [[pinot noir]], and Anna has juice. 'Merci, Paris!' Anna laughs.

title: Summer in Italy and Spain
scene: Max and his parents go on a cruise on a big liner. In Venice they take a gondola along a canal and drink coffee in a piazza, see an old villa and a palace, and in Spain they walk on the promenade, buy souvenirs, dance at a fiesta, drink chardonnay and meet a compatriot from Kyiv.

words.ex: We went on a cruise to the Caribbean.
We sailed across the ocean on a huge liner.
We took a gondola ride in Venice.
Small boats travel along the canal every day.
We had coffee in the piazza.
We visited an old palace in the city.
I bought a mug as a souvenir.
I'd like a glass of chardonnay, please.
He met a compatriot while traveling in Spain.
We met friends at a small wine bar downtown.
We ordered a glass of pinot with dinner.
Pinot noir goes well with salmon.

old_story: This summer, Max and his parents go on a [[cruise]]. Their [[liner]] is as big as a small town. In Venice, they take a [[gondola]] along a narrow [[canal]]. Then they drink coffee in a sunny [[piazza]]. Max takes photos of an old [[villa]] and a pink [[palace]]. A few days later, the ship stops in Spain. They walk along the [[promenade]] by the sea. Max buys a small guitar as a [[souvenir]] for Anna. In the evening, the whole town dances at a [[fiesta]]. Later, his parents sit in a [[wine bar]] and order [[chardonnay]]. A man at the next table hears them speak Ukrainian. He is a [[compatriot]] from Kyiv, and he lives near their street!

title: Rainy days in London
scene: During her summer course in London Anna learns to dress for rain: a trench coat, a poncho, a warm jumper, a fleece and a shawl. She pays in sterling, eats scones and toffee, sees an old painting sold for a hundred guineas, and asks a constable for directions.

words.ex: She wore a long beige trench coat in the rain.
Take a poncho in case it rains.
I wear a fleece when it's cold outside.
She wrapped a shawl around her shoulders.
I had a scone with jam and tea.
I bought a bag of toffee for the trip.
The painting sold for a hundred guineas long ago.
I bought a warm wool cape for the autumn.

old_story: Anna is taking a summer course in London. On the first day, it rains, and she gets very wet. Her teacher says, 'In London, you need a [[trench coat]].' On Saturday, Anna buys a cheap [[poncho]] and a warm [[jumper]]. She also gets a soft [[fleece]] and a long [[shawl]] for Mama. She pays in [[sterling]] and counts the coins slowly. She eats a [[scone]] with jam and buys [[toffee]] for Max. Later, she visits a small art museum. One old painting there once cost a hundred [[guineas|guinea]]. When Anna gets lost in the rain, a kind [[constable]] helps her. She is wet, but happy.

title: Letters in Athens
scene: In Athens Anna tries to read the signs. She learns the Greek letters - alpha, gamma, kappa, mu, theta, phi, chi, sigma and omega - visits the old citadel on a hill and gets lost in a garden labyrinth.

words.ex: Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet.
Gamma is the third letter of the Greek alphabet.
Kappa is the tenth letter of the Greek alphabet.
Mu is a letter of the Greek alphabet.
Theta is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet.
Phi is a letter of the Greek alphabet.
Chi is the 22nd letter of the Greek alphabet.
Sigma is a letter of the Greek alphabet.
Omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet.
We got lost in the hedge labyrinth.
The number pi is about 3.14.
The beta of the app is open to testers.
The river forms a delta near the sea.

old_story: Anna spends a week in Athens with her friend Max. The street signs are in Greek, so she can't read them. Max buys her a little book about Greek letters. The first letter is [[alpha]], and the third is [[gamma]]. Anna finds [[kappa]] and [[mu]] on a bus sign. On a café menu, she sees [[theta]] and [[phi]]. [[Chi|chi]] looks like an X, and [[sigma]] looks a bit like E. 'And [[omega]] is the last one!' Max says. Then they climb up to the old [[citadel]] on the hill. Below it, they get lost in a garden [[labyrinth]]. Anna reads the Greek exit sign and finds the way out!
